rules.penalty: Up to $500 for a first offense, $750 for a second, and $1,000 for each later offense; the overcharge is refunded to the applicant.
rules.title: Rental application fee cap
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent cannot charge more than $50 for a rental application fee. The cap goes up each year with inflation.
rules.requirement_es: Un propietario o su agente no puede cobrar más de $50 por la solicitud de alquiler. El límite se ajusta cada año según la inflación.
rules.coverage_text: Applications to lease or sublease residential rental property, except units in one- or two-family dwellings and real estate licensees who are not the landlord.
rules.quote: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
